scheme_name: Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti  Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana
description:
Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2021. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the last rites of registered workers who die while working at construction sites. 

The scheme aims to ensure that the families of deceased workers do not face financial hardships during a difficult time. 

The government has set a target to provide timely financial support to at least 10,000 families annually under this scheme. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is fixed at ₹20,000. 

This amount is intended to cover the expenses associated with the last rites and funeral services. 

The scheme specifically targets registered construction workers who are part of the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act. 

To be eligible for this scheme, the worker must be registered under the BOCW Act. 

The worker must also have been actively engaged in construction work at the time of their death. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the worker must be a resident of India and must have a valid registration number. 

The application process for this scheme is straightforward. 

The family members of the deceased worker must apply for the assistance within 30 days of the worker's death. 

The application must be submitted to the local labor department office. 

Required documents include the death certificate of the worker. 

The family must also provide a copy of the worker’s registration certificate. 

Additionally, a bank account statement or passbook of the deceased worker is required. 

The application form can be obtained from the local labor department office or downloaded from the official government website. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement is generally completed within 7 days of verification. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

The local labor department offices are responsible for the execution and monitoring of the scheme at the state level. 

Contact details for the local labor department can usually be found on the official state government websites. 

This scheme is part of a broader initiative to enhance the welfare of construction workers in India. 

The construction sector is one of the largest employers in India. 

It employs millions of workers across various states. 

However, workers in this sector often face significant risks and challenges. 

Many workers are engaged in hazardous conditions without adequate safety measures. 

The Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana aims to mitigate some of these challenges. 

By providing financial assistance for last rites, the scheme helps in reducing the financial burden on the bereaved families. 

The scheme is expected to improve the overall welfare of construction workers and their families. 

It also aims to encourage more workers to register under the BOCW Act. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

Many families have benefited from the timely assistance provided under this scheme. 

The government continues to promote awareness about the scheme among construction workers. 

Workshops and informational sessions are conducted to educate workers about their rights and available benefits. 

The scheme is part of the government's commitment to ensuring social security for informal workers. 

The financial assistance provided is crucial for families who may lose their primary breadwinner. 

The scheme reflects the government's recognition of the contributions made by construction workers to the economy. 

Efforts are being made to streamline the application process further. 

This includes digitizing records and simplifying documentation requirements. 

The government aims to make the scheme more accessible to workers across the country. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme also emphasizes the importance of safety measures at construction sites. 

The government is working on initiatives to improve working conditions for construction workers. 

This includes providing training and resources for safer construction practices. 

Overall, the Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana is a crucial step towards enhancing the welfare of construction workers in India. 

It addresses the immediate needs of families in distress while also promoting long-term welfare and safety in the construction sector. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over time with feedback from beneficiaries and stakeholders. 

The government remains committed to ensuring that the benefits reach those who need them the most. 

In conclusion, this welfare scheme is an essential part of India's social security framework for informal workers. 

It demonstrates the government's dedication to improving the lives of vulnerable populations. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a lifeline for many families. 

It helps them navigate the challenges posed by the loss of a loved one in the construction sector. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's ongoing efforts to support the working class in India.
